title: How do you get consistent photos for an entire product collection?
h1: 📷 Consistent photos: boost your product consistency
metaTitle: 📸 Consistent product visuals: unify your collection
description: ⚙️ Gain consistency with Orbitvu. Get aligned visuals for your entire product collection.
introText:
In the field of e-commerce, homogeneous and professional visuals are strategic elements that strengthen the credibility of your brand and promote sales. 📊

But how do you ensure perfect consistency when working on multiple products, with different shapes, sizes and textures? Thanks to technologies such as those of Orbitvu, it is now possible to industrialize visual production while obtaining an impeccable result.

In this article, we guide you step by step to get consistent photos of an entire product collection, using the example of three lipsticks. 💄

steps.title: Create a session on Orbitvu Station
steps.content:
First, we'll start by setting up a dedicated session for your product in the Orbitvu Station software. Enter information specific to your project, such as the name of the collection or the dimensions of the products you are going to photograph.

The tool offers integration with barcode scanners to automatically identify products, making it even easier to manage your files. 📂

steps.title: Focus the product and activate the AI assistant
steps.content:
Once your session is created, place your lipstick in the center of the photo studio, using the built-in laser for precise positioning. 📍

You can also use your screen to check that your product is well centered and in front of the camera. 💻

Then, activate Orbitvu's artificial intelligence by clicking on the AI icon. The AI assistant analyzes the product in order to suggest the best lighting parameters. 💡

steps.title: Shooting and editing the photo
steps.content:
ActivateIQ Mask and it will automatically remove the background, while respecting predefined settings for colors, brightness, and shadows.

steps.title: Create a ghost image for the same positioning
steps.content:
To ensure the same consistency across the following products, use the ghost image feature. 👻

This process involves superimposing a semi-transparent image of your first lipstick onto the interface in real time. So you can position your second product in exactly the same place. 📍

steps.title: Reproduce the position with another product
steps.content:
Use the same method for all of your products. Thanks to the phantom image, repositioning the product becomes intuitive. 💄

Once in place, repeat the previous process: shooting, removing the background, and optimizing using automated tools.

faqs.question: What is the added value of AI for photographing a range of products?
faqs.answer: AI automatically optimizes lighting, focus, and shooting angle, avoiding time-consuming and expensive manual adjustments. It guarantees a homogeneous result even if the products vary in size or color.

faqs.question: What is the impact on a brand's return on investment (ROI)?
faqs.answer: A consistent catalog builds credibility and simplifies the shopping experience, which decreases product returns and increases sales. Automation also reduces labor costs and speeds time to market.

faqs.question: Can we integrate a bar code into the metadata for each visual in order to simplify logistics?
faqs.answer: Yes, Orbitvu Station offers barcode scanner integration. Each visual can thus be associated with a SKU or an EAN, facilitating back-office management (PIM/DAM) and updating the catalog on different platforms.

faqs.question: Do you need advanced photography skills to set up this standardized workflow?
faqs.answer: No, Orbitvu Station and its AI Assistant are designed to be accessible to everyone. Even without experience, you can achieve professional results thanks to the automation of lighting and framing settings.

faqs.question: What time savings can be expected by automating the production flow?
faqs.answer: Auto crop, repeat settings, and batch management functions can cut your shooting and editing time in half or more. You thus free up your resources for tasks with higher added value, improving the overall productivity of your business.
